# appdynamics_schedule (Resource)

An AppDynamics alerting schedule, used to control when health rules are evaluated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "appdynamics_schedule" "business_hours" {
  application_id = 42
  name           = "Business Hours"
  description    = "Weekdays 9am-6pm Pacific"
  timezone       = "America/Los_Angeles"

  schedule_configuration = {
    schedule_frequency = "WEEKLY"
    days                = ["MONDAY", "TUESDAY", "WEDNESDAY", "THURSDAY", "FRIDAY"]
    start_time          = "09:00"
    end_time            = "18:00"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (Number) ID of the business application this schedule belongs to.
- `name` (String)
- `schedule_configuration` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule_configuration))
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone ID, e.g. America/Los_Angeles.

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--schedule_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule_configuration`

Required:

- `schedule_frequency` (String) One of ONE_TIME, DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DATE, MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DAY, CUSTOM.

Optional:

- `day` (List of String) Weekday names. Used by MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DAY.
- `days` (List of String) Weekday names (e.g. MONDAY). Used by WEEKLY.
- `end_cron` (String) UNIX cron expression. Used by CUSTOM.
- `end_date` (String) DD/MM/YYYY. Used by ONE_TIME and MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DATE.
- `end_time` (String) HH:MM (24-hour). Used by all frequencies except CUSTOM.
- `occurrence` (String) One of FIRST, SECOND, THIRD, FOURTH, LAST. Used by MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DAY.
- `start_cron` (String) UNIX cron expression. Used by CUSTOM.
- `start_date` (String) DD/MM/YYYY. Used by ONE_TIME and MONTHLY_SPECIFIC_DATE.
- `start_time` (String) HH:MM (24-hour). Used by all frequencies except CUSTOM.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import ID is "<application_id>/<schedule_id>"
terraform import appdynamics_schedule.business_hours 42/17
```
